quicksilver.options.metal.tooltip:
On: Quicksilver draws the game with Metal, the Mac's own graphics.
Off: the game uses OpenGL or Vulkan, as the Graphics API row on Sodium's General page says. Vitrail's shader packs draw only on Metal or Vulkan, not on OpenGL.
Applies after a restart.
quicksilver.options.colors.tooltip:
Vivid: the strong colors of Display P3.
Accurate: colors matched from sRGB, as OpenGL and Vulkan show them unless a mod changes it.
Automatic: Vivid when the mod mac-colorspace-rollback is installed, otherwise Accurate.
Applies at once.
quicksilver.options.hud.tooltip: Apple's Metal Performance HUD in a corner of the screen: frames per second, GPU time, memory and whether the frames go straight to the display.
quicksilver.options.hud.restart: Turning it on applies after a restart.
quicksilver.options.locked: Set by the launch command (%s), so this page cannot change it.
quicksilver.options.locked_launcher: Set by the launcher's environment (%s), so the HUD stays off and this page cannot change it.
quicksilver.options.not_on_metal: The game is not running on Metal now.
quicksilver.options.graphics_api_note: Quicksilver: while Use Metal is on (Video Settings, Quicksilver), Metal draws the game and this choice waits.
